description: This file defines the IntegrationTestFixture class used for setting up and managing an in-process Orleans test cluster for journaling tests. It includes setup and teardown logic, and configuration of the cluster with a volatile state machine storage provider.

classes.name: IntegrationTestFixture
classes.description: Base class for journaling tests with common setup using InProcessTestCluster, implementing IAsyncLifetime for async initialization and disposal.

methods.name: IntegrationTestFixture
methods.description: Constructor initializing the in-process test cluster with a volatile state machine storage provider.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Virtual method allowing subclasses to customize the test cluster configuration.

methods.description: Async method to deploy the cluster before tests run.
